item.title: What Is the Pomodoro Technique and How Do You Use It? (Step-by-Step Guide)
item.description: What is the Pomodoro Technique and how does it work? The 25/5 cycle, the long-break rule, Francesco Cirillo's original method, common mistakes and how students and remote workers can adapt the timings.

item.title: Pomodoro vs 52/17 vs Flowtime: An Honest Comparison of Focus Techniques

item.title: How Many Pomodoros a Day? Realistic Targets and the Mistake Everyone Makes

item.title: How to Stop Procrastinating: Why We Do It and What Actually Works Today

item.title: The Best Background Sounds for Studying: Rain, Café, White Noise and Music Compared
